<title level="1" right="Action">[Fire Breath](/Actions.aspx?ID=2282) <actions string="Two Actions" /></title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 209

**Frequency** once per hour

</column>

---

The riding drake breathes a 30-foot cone of fire, dealing 1d6 fire damage for every 2 levels the drake has to all creatures in the area ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). This uses a trained DC using the drake's Constitution modifier or an expert DC if the drake is specialized.
name: Fire Breath
